_comment: HNL Cabibbo-suppressed (us-bar) CC channels: the tau
strange width (~2.9% of the hadronic total) is resonance-dominated
and is carried by exclusive electroweak modes, NOT by the string.
br_tau = measured tau^- -> X^- nu branching ratios (PDG); for the
HNL these scale with the same master substitution as the J=1
or equivalently through the standard f_K / f_K* / f_K1 decay-
constant formulas already present in HNL width codes.
K1 split per PDG tau -> K1(1270)/K1(1400) analyses.
Kaon-pole (J=0) and K*(892) (J=1 vector) are usually already
exclusive channels in EventCalc; K1 modes (J=1 axial, K pi pi)
